the development of new tools and methodologies to support the implementation of regionalization in LCA and to improve the quality of LCA results.
the question of how to best prioritize the efforts of LCA practitioners and LCA database developers for regionalization in LCA.
the improvement of LCA interpretation through the use of GSA.
